content: MK judges that 'it would seem' Ṣāʾin al-Dīn alludes elsewhere, generically and with patent hostility, to the Ḥurufiyya as one among several messianic Sufi movements marked by antinomianism and worldly ambition, and that he was particularly incensed at their lack of intellectual rigour (his R. al-Bāʾiyya introduction is MK's example).
refers_to_primary: MK on Ibn Turka's allusions to Hurufism
